lessons.title: Language: Reported Speech with Reporting Verbs
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Language: Reported Speech with Reporting Verbs.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK 12.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn ôn thi THPT & ĐGNL.

concepts.term: Reported Speech with specialized reporting verbs
concepts.definition: Instead of merely using 'said' or 'told', advanced reporting employs verbs like advise, invite, remind, promise, offer, apologize for, congratulate on.
concepts.example: The manager advised me to improve my digital skills before the interview.
concepts.essence: Accurately conveying speaker's illocutionary intent and pragmatic nuance.

concepts.definition: Hard skills are teachable, measurable technical abilities (coding, bookkeeping, operating machinery). Soft skills are interpersonal and emotional competencies (communication, teamwork, adaptability).
concepts.example: In the modern AI era, soft skills like critical thinking and empathy become decisive factors for career promotion.
concepts.essence: Complementary skill architecture required for sustainable employment.

rules.statement: Tense backshift rule in reported speech
rules.meaning: When the reporting verb is in the past (said, asked), verbs in direct speech shift back one tense (Present Simple -> Past Simple; Present Perfect -> Past Perfect; Will -> Would; Can -> Could). Time and place expressions also adapt.
rules.example: 'I am applying for this job today' -> She said that she was applying for that job that day.
rules.essence: Re-anchoring speech acts to the speaker's past perspective.

workedExamples.prompt: Change into reported speech: 'Will you attend the career orientation workshop tomorrow?' Nam asked Lan.
steps: Step 1: Identify yes/no question structure -> use 'if' or 'whether'.
Step 3: Backshift modal verb: will -> would.
Step 4: Shift time word: tomorrow -> the next day / the following day.
Step 5: Assemble: Nam asked Lan if she would attend the career orientation workshop the following day.
workedExamples.answer: Nam asked Lan if she would attend the career orientation workshop the following day.

commonMistakes.mistake: Maintaining question word order in reported questions: *Nam asked Lan if would she attend...*
commonMistakes.why: Reported questions take affirmative declarative word order: Subject + Verb (if she would attend).
